lugares.desc: Interactive science museum with a freshwater aquarium, vivarium and dinosaur halls; the city's top family outing.
lugares.tip: Ticket office closes at 4 p.m. on weekdays; buy the combo with the Planetarium.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Parque Explora (acuario y ciencia), Cra. 52 #73-75, Medellín&travelmode=walking

lugares.desc: A serene dining room inside the Botanical Garden, serving light contemporary cooking beside a reflecting pool.
lugares.tip: Pair it with a visit to the garden and Parque Explora. Daytime only; closed Mondays.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=In Situ, Jardín Botánico, Cl. 73 #51D-14, Aranjuez, Medellín&travelmode=walking

lugares.n: Santa Elena: silleteros y fincas de flores
lugares.desc: Mountain district where silletero families grow flowers and build the Feria's flower 'silletas'; cool climate and cafés.
lugares.tip: Book a tour with a silletero family (about 4 hours); bring layers, it's several degrees cooler.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Santa Elena: silleteros y fincas de flores, Parque principal de Santa Elena, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Santa Elena: silleteros y fincas de flores, Parque principal de Santa Elena, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.dir: Escaleras eléctricas, Cl. 35 con Cra. 108B, Las Independencias
lugares.cierra: abierto a diario; ir de día
lugares.desc: A neighborhood transformed by outdoor escalators, murals and hip hop; a local-led tour tells its story of violence and resilience.
lugares.tip: Go with a local guide in the morning to beat crowds; watch your phone. The walk takes about 2.5 hours.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Comuna 13 y graffitour, Escaleras eléctricas, Cl. 35 con Cra. 108B, Las Independencias, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Comuna 13 y graffitour, Escaleras eléctricas, Cl. 35 con Cra. 108B, Las Independencias, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.n: Tour de café en finca (Sabaneta / San Sebastián de Palmitas)
lugares.zona: Sur o occidente del Valle de Aburrá
lugares.desc: Half day at a family farm: from bean to cup, picking, roasting and tasting, with mountain views.
lugares.tip: Pick tours with pickup from El Poblado; Sabaneta is about 30–45 minutes away.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Tour de café en finca (Sabaneta / San Sebastián de Palmitas), Varía según operador, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Tour de café en finca (Sabaneta / San Sebastián de Palmitas), Varía según operador, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.dir: Estación Arví, Línea L del Metrocable
lugares.cierra: martes (mantenimiento de parque y Línea L)
lugares.desc: Cable car ride over hillside barrios to a 16,000-hectare forest with trails, a farmers' market and cool mountain air.
lugares.tip: Metro to Acevedo, Line K to Santo Domingo, then Line L (separate cash fare). Bring a jacket: it's chilly.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Metrocable a Parque Arví, Estación Arví, Línea L del Metrocable, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Metrocable a Parque Arví, Estación Arví, Línea L del Metrocable, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.dir: Km 6 vía Medellín–San Pedro de los Milagros, cerca al Estadero El Voladero
lugares.desc: About 15-minute tandem flight over the Aburrá Valley with a certified pilot; Medellín's most popular adrenaline fix.
lugares.tip: Fly in the morning when winds are steadier; book an operator with insurance included.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Parapente en San Félix, Km 6 vía Medellín–San Pedro de los Milagros, cerca al Estadero El Voladero, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Parapente en San Félix, Km 6 vía Medellín–San Pedro de los Milagros, cerca al Estadero El Voladero, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.dir: El Peñón de Guatapé, vía Guatapé
lugares.desc: A 740-step monolith overlooking a maze of reservoirs, plus Antioquia's most photogenic town of colorful zócalo friezes.
lugares.tip: Leave before 7 a.m. to climb without lines or heat; add a boat ride on the reservoir.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Guatapé y Piedra del Peñol, El Peñón de Guatapé, vía Guatapé, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Guatapé y Piedra del Peñol, El Peñón de Guatapé, vía Guatapé, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.dir: Parque principal de Santa Fe de Antioquia
lugares.desc: Former colonial capital with cobbled streets and warm weather, plus the Puente de Occidente suspension bridge over the Cauca.
lugares.tip: Light clothes and sunscreen: it's much hotter than Medellín. Try the tamarind sweets.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Santa Fe de Antioquia, Parque principal de Santa Fe de Antioquia, Medellín&travelmode=walking
lugares.rd: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Santa Fe de Antioquia, Parque principal de Santa Fe de Antioquia, Medellín&travelmode=driving

lugares.desc: Heritage town of colorful balconies, a neo-Gothic basilica and coffee farms; best with at least one overnight.
lugares.tip: It's a 3–4-hour drive: better as an overnight escape than a day trip.
lugares.rw: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=6.2096216,-75.5660737&destination=Jardín (pueblo patrimonio), Parque principal de Jardín, Medellín&travelmode=walking

suites.desc: Four-bedroom duplex penthouse above Medellín with a private jacuzzi, a generous living room for gathering and premium sound. Made for families or friends.
Four-bedroom duplex built for groups: a private balcony with jacuzzi facing the city, a fully equipped kitchen and a warm two-level living space.
Four-bedroom duplex with en-suite baths, double-height ceilings, a marble-island kitchen and a private indoor pool framed by a vertical garden.
Three-bedroom suite with queen beds for up to six guests, a private jacuzzi and a balcony overlooking the city.
Billed as the largest two-bedroom hotel suite in El Poblado: a wide balcony, jacuzzi, full kitchen and a private bathroom in each bedroom.
Two-bedroom apartment with a private jacuzzi in each room, a fully equipped kitchen, dining area and large windows with city views.
Clean-lined two-bedroom suite with a jacuzzi on its private balcony facing the city, an open living area and high-end sound.
Spacious room with floor-to-ceiling windows, a private jacuzzi, a sitting area and a marble bathroom with rain shower.
An intimate room for two with its own heated jacuzzi, a queen bed and a bathroom with excellent water pressure and temperature.
A 24 m² room with an open-air jacuzzi on its private balcony and city views, plus a queen bed and modern comforts.
A room for couples with a heated jacuzzi, a balcony with city views and a queen bed.
A roomy, multi-purpose suite with a lounge, ergonomic desk, floor-to-ceiling windows and photogenic ambient lighting.
A spacious room with a lounge, work desk, ample wardrobe and plenty of natural light from its large windows.
A room for two with a queen bed and a private jacuzzi, plus a bathroom with strong water pressure.
A queen room with a private balcony and panoramic city views.
A comfortable room with a queen bed, a stylish bathroom and every essential for a restful city stay.
A compact, elegant room with a queen bed, a private bathroom and all the essentials.

eventos.d: Medellín's signature festival: silletero flower parade, classic cars, street stages and concerts. The Silleteros Parade closes it.
Millions of lights and hand-crafted figures glow along Parques del Río, downtown, Las Palmas and La 70, 6 p.m. to midnight.
Colombia's leading fashion week at Plaza Mayor: runways, a trade fair and parties across the city.
One of the world's largest poetry festivals: free readings in parks, theaters and barrios with poets from every continent.
International jazz and world music festival with mostly free concerts and masterclasses.
Free literary fair at the Botanical Garden with authors, publishers, talks and children's activities.
Free rock, punk, hip hop and alternative music festival, one of Latin America's largest.
Medellín honors Carlos Gardel, who died here in 1935, with milongas, competitions and tango concerts.

eventos.n: Christmas Festival and Myths & Legends Parade
eventos.d: Christmas program with troupes recreating Antioquian folk legends; a complement to the Christmas lights.
